merger_name: Australian Venue Co – assets of Black Nugget Hotel Motel, Bartletts Tavern and all associated detached bottle shops
merger_description:
AVC Operations Pty Limited (AVC), a subsidiary of Australian Venue Co. Holdings Ltd (AVC Holdings), proposes to acquire substantially all of the assets of two licensed venues, Bartlett's Tavern, Rockhampton and Black Nugget Hotel Motel Moranbah, and all associated detached bottle shops (DBS) from Central Hospitality Services Pty Ltd (CHS) and Athena Hospitality Group Pty Ltd (Athena) respectively (together, the Vendors) (the Acquisition). The Acquisition also includes the assignment of the lease for each premises being acquired by AVC.

AVC operates over 200 licensed venues throughout Australia and New Zealand, primarily pubs, as well as some bars, clubs and licensed restaurants.

Black Nugget Hotel Motel is a licensed motel and hotel located at 81 Batchelor Parade, Moranbah QLD. The licence also covers, Moranbah DBS Premises, Shop 6, Moranbah Fair, St Francis Drive, Moranbah (together, the Black Nugget Hotel Motel Business).

Bartlett’s Tavern is a pub and grill located at 166 Kent Street, Rockhampton QLD. The licence also covers two DBS (1) Berserker DBS Premises,169 High Street, Berserker; and (2) Highway A1 DBS Premises, 86 Derby Street, Rockhampton (together, the Bartlett's Tavern Business).

Both venues are typical Australian pubs with facilities including a bistro, sports bar, gaming room, function room, beer garden and DBS. Black Nugget Hotel Motel also includes a motel accommodation premises.

events.title: Australian Venue Co – assets of Black Nugget Hotel Motel, Bartletts Tavern and all associated detached bottle shops - Phase 1 Determination
events.determination_commission_division: Determination made by Commissioner Williams pursuant to a delegation under section 25(1) of the Act

determination_table_content.details:
AVC Operations Pty Limited (AVC), a subsidiary of Australian Venue
Co. Holdings Ltd (AVC Holdings), proposes to acquire substantially
all of the assets of two licensed venues, Bartlett's Tavern,
Rockhampton and Black Nugget Hotel Motel Moranbah, and all
associated detached bottle shops from Central Hospitality Services
Pty Ltd (CHS) and Athena Hospitality Group Pty Ltd (Athena)
respectively (together, the Vendors) (the Acquisition). The
Acquisition also includes the assignment of the lease for each
premises being acquired by AVC.

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has
determined under section 51ABZE(1) of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) that the Acquisition may be put into effect.

The acquirer, AVC, operates over 200 licensed venues throughout
Australia and New Zealand, primarily pubs, as well as some bars,
clubs and licensed restaurants. In the Rockhampton region, AVC
operates the Leichhardt Hotel and Berserker Tavern.
One of the targets, Black Nugget Hotel Motel, is a licensed motel and
hotel located in Moranbah Queensland. The licence also covers, the
Moranbah detached bottle shop premises, Shop 6, Moranbah Fair, St
Francis Drive, Moranbah (together, the Black Nugget Hotel Motel
Business).
The other target, Bartlett’s Tavern, is a pub and grill in Rockhampton
Queensland. The licence also covers two detached bottle shops (1)
Berserker detached bottle shop premises,169 High Street, Berserker;
and (2) Highway A1 detached bottle shop premises, 86 Derby Street,
Rockhampton (together, the Bartlett's Tavern Business).
Both venues are typical Australian pubs with facilities including a
bistro, sports bar, gaming room, function room, beer garden and
detached bottle shop. Black Nugget Hotel Motel also includes a
motel accommodation premises.

The parties overlap in the retail supply of on-premises hospitality
services (including bar service, casual dining, gaming facilities and
entertainment) in the Rockhampton region of Queensland.

When making a determination in Phase 1, the Australian Competition
and Consumer Commission (ACCC) undertakes a competition
assessment and considers whether it is appropriate for an
acquisition to be approved or subject to further assessment in
Phase 2 in accordance with section 51ABZJ of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act). In doing so, the ACCC must have
regard to the object of the Act and all relevant matters, including the
interests of consumers.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notified acquisitions, see the ACCC’s merger assessment guidelines
and interim merger process guidelines.
In conducting its competition assessment, the ACCC has considered
the information and documents that were submitted with the
notification form and publicly available information.
The ACCC has determined that the Acquisition may be put into
effect as it considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to have the
effect of substantially lessening competition in any market. In
reaching its decision, and based on the material before it, the ACCC
makes the following findings:
• The market share aggregation arising from the Acquisition is
minimal in the local area surrounding the Bartlett's Tavern
Business.
• Post-acquisition, AVC will likely continue to face competition
from alternative hospitality venues in the Rockhampton region.
• AVC does not currently overlap with the Black Nugget Hotel
Motel Business in Moranbah.

A notifying party, or other person who has been allowed to do so by
the Australian Competition Tribunal, may apply for review if they are
dissatisfied with the determination. Pursuant to section 100C of the
Act, applications for review of the determination are to be made to
the Australian Competition Tribunal before the end of 14 calendar
days after this statement of reasons was included on the ACCC’s
Acquisitions Register. To confirm whether there has been any
application for review, please contact the Australian Competition
Tribunal.
